name: visited-tracker.attention-select
purpose: Return up to 20 revision-aware review candidates without reserving or recording visits; compose in any authorized scenario improvement program.
assumptions: Visited Tracker is running; campaign scope is authorized.
invariants: Preview never grants review credit or reserves a claim.
Changed revisions are eligible regardless of lifetime visits.
Exactly one bounded envelope; at most one read and twenty candidate rows.
Candidate bytes never exceed 48000; truncation is explicit.

signals.candidates: At most twenty candidates, each with path, revision, score and reviewed state.
signals.reserved: Always false; caller must claim before parallel work.
signals.truncated: True when the 48000-byte candidate budget cuts the requested result; status becomes partial.

outputs.evidence: Binding identity and snapshot observation metadata.
